primary_metric.description: Exactly one (e.g., cost_per_lead, cost_per_conversion, roas, cpa). No portfolio of metrics.

attribution_window.description: e.g., 7-day click + 1-day view. Must match Meta-side configuration.

conversion_event.description: Exact event name; matches client project.json compliance_posture.expected_conversion_event.

sample_size_minimum.description: Minimum conversions per cell before a decision is allowed. Practical floor: 30.

stopping_rules.description: Observable conditions that trigger an early stop.

locked.description: Once locked, Stage 6 will refuse to read out without it. Amendments allowed only with operator approval + recorded reason.
